title: Richards Conquers Theewaterskloof to Retain DF95 Global Title
quotes: Great Britain's Craig Richards successfully defended his title
Held at Theewater Sports Club near Villiersdorp from 16–23 October
The defending champion established his authority early, winning seven of the 11 qualifying races before adding another two victories during the nine-race Gold Fleet finals
Finishing on just 29 nett points, Richards secured the championship ahead of Sweden's Ulf Lindberg on 45.4 points, with Norway's Odd Ornulf Stray completing the podium on 60 points.
